capabilities: Force files to open in new tabs from any opening method
Focus an existing tab instead of opening a duplicate
Open new tabs in the background so focus stays on the current note
Keep same-file heading and block navigation in the current tab
Create a synced split view with an edit pane and a reading view pane
extras: The README explains that it monkey-patches Workspace.getLeaf() and openLinkText(), and exposes a window.openInNewTabAPI for other plugins.
problem: By default Obsidian reuses the current tab when opening files from the Quick Switcher, search, backlinks, or links, so navigation replaces the note you were reading.

relations.evidence: Note Toolbar helpers button (if obsidian-note-toolbar is installed)

summary: Tab-behavior plugin that forces files to open in new tabs instead of replacing the current tab, across all of Obsidian's opening methods.
